transcript.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Your colleague said I can give you the new card here and you'll update it: 4111 1111 1111 1111. Org quarry-labs.

Sorry for the confusion. Support can’t accept or update card details. Please change your autopay card yourself in **Console → Billing settings**. Don’t send card details to Support; no case is needed for a card update.
And where can I manage our payment cards myself?
In Redwood Console, select the **quarry-labs** organization and open **Billing settings** to manage the card used for autopay.
